technology_name: SPOTCOMS: Crop Monitoring and Yield Prediction System
institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
description: SPOTCOMS is a growth simulation model of sweet potato which predicts the crop phenology in response to environmental factors.It mimics the growth and development of sweet potato and helps to study crop growth and to calculate growth responses to the environment.This model is validated for nearly 30 Indian varieties and other varieties of Uganda, Indonesia, Vietnam, China and the Philippines
applications:
Agricultural research institutions and crop modeling centers
Precision agriculture and digital farming solution providers
Government agriculture departments and crop forecasting programs
Sweet potato breeding and varietal evaluation programs
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs), commercial farms, and agro-advisory service providers
